import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicates based on penguin_id
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['penguin_id'])
    
    # Fix island label variants (strip spaces, fix typos)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Fix sex label variants (normalize case)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to number
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to number
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and sum body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
